name: pelotense-it
description: Pelotense IT - Dashboard de Controle de Chamados de TI
author: Cristian Raffi Cunha

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend,evolution -c blue,green,magenta "npm run backend" "npm run dev:front" "npm run evolution"
scripts.dev:app: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run backend" "npm run dev:front"

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install && cd ../evolution-api && npm install --legacy-peer-deps
